title: Breast ultrasound: more lesions proven by biopsy or follow-up
description: Breast ultrasound images from Breast-Lesions-USG (one patient each), every lesion outlined freehand by a radiologist experienced in breast ultrasound who also recorded its BI-RADS descriptors: malignant lesions proven by biopsy (invasive carcinoma of no special type, lobular, mucinous, micropapillary, DCIS and rarer types), benign lesions proven by biopsy, and benign lesions confirmed on follow-up. Chosen by rule (one lesion per image, every diagnosis represented) and checked by eye with the outline drawn. Cropped 8-bit B-mode frames with their true pixel size.
